priority: Main next research line; no small-model success prerequisite

latest_observed.note: Published PR417 snapshot, not a live SSH observation

start_conditions: At least two admitted public source datasets with native semantics and one target dataset version; episode/task/scene inventory and TRAIN splits frozen
Real batches forward/backward to declared trainable leaves; finite effective gradients; no domain-I/O cross-update
Full model/optimizer/RNG/each-domain cursor and schedule recovery demonstrated on same lineage
Actual authorized compute, storage, owner and finite allocation bound

data.target_bootstrap: New version using C20 plus individually admitted historical complete PLACE; reject any member conflicting with held-out scene or collection lineage
data.minimum_to_start: Two actual admitted public sources and recorded task/episode coverage; may begin formal prefix while the predeclared version is smaller than goal, report actual scale honestly
data.source_goal_accounting: Frozen inventory must show unique episode, task, scene and per-domain windows, not just visits
data.preserve_old_source_DEV_TEST: Preserve original splits/identity; DEV evaluation only, old TEST unused
data.preserve_old_target_DEV_TEST: Preserve original splits/identity; DEV evaluation only, old TEST unused

domain_semantics.Go2: G7/H40/50ms; prior actual command; original decoder/safety
domain_semantics.RoboDojo: Audited ARX X5 subset: native bimanual H50/30Hz future logged reference and original valid-window rule. New embodiment/collection requires independent clock/frame/action-state alignment contract (official sources include25/30Hz); do not inherit evidence blindly.
domain_semantics.LIBERO: Official native observation/action/clock; separate domain I/O and TRAIN-only statistics; no unproved physical retargeting

data.midrun_change: No silent dataset changes. New target/source data enters a separately named curriculum version at a recorded checkpoint; do not call mixed-version results a pure compute scaling curve

training.parent: Verified official SLA_base, with new common initialization; no B500 endpoint or old optimizer as default parent
training.common_initialization: Identical shared parameters and target I/O for both arms; domain-private I/O derived from matching base shapes or a frozen common seeded initializer before any update
training.target_statistics: Reuse C20 statistics for audited C20/PLACE bootstrap when original validity checks pass; otherwise declare a new target statistics version before launch

trainable.domain_IO: trainable only from their own domain losses

training.note: Project scaling recipe inspired by official parameter scope, not an exact official reproduction; no mandatory full VLM unfreezing
training.target_loss: Original FM32 +0.1 XYZ +0.1 gripper-speed +1.0 physical-width L_w (D5-W definition); no delta term in first scale recipe
training.mixture_loss: L_target +1.5 mean(L_RoboDojo_FM) +1.5 mean(L_LIBERO_FM); each domain mean before weighting; one combined update
training.target_aux: Four full 10-step generated target H40 per optimizer update; mean40 then mean4; same target auxiliary and target RNG stream in both arms
training.comparison_limit: MIX20K vs TGT5K is not a matched source-only causal contrast; MIX5K vs TGT5K is matched updates/target exposure, with unequal compute
training.microbatch: Choose from measured memory; gradient accumulation to exact effective batches; do not change effective batch silently
training.precision: Explicitly version dtype/FP32 highest contracts and backend before start; no implicit BF16 fallback to bypass historical failures

schedule.note: Proposed conservative cosine schedule; freeze exact table after technical gradient/throughput inspection, before optimizing formal first update; no tuning on native DEV

training.resume: Same model/Adam/RNG/global LR step/each-domain cursor across finite allocations; never reset fresh Adam every500
training.spatial_alignment_followup: Separate official-style alignment comparison, not a new prerequisite
training.common_target_data_prefix: Identical target manifest/version, sample bank and any preregistered data evolution in both arms through update5000; default fixed common data
training.parameter_partition: Mutually exclusive shared/target/each-source parameter lists before first update; no duplicate ownership
training.inactive_domain_update: No parameter, optimizer moment or AdamW decay update for inactive domain I/O; zero gradient alone insufficient

science_DEV.interpretation: Repeated DEV learning curve, never relabel as TEST; no gate on high success before training continues

fresh_confirmation.condition: Frozen endpoint and finite deployment admission; separate new scenes; no claim of held-out randomized causal treatment effect

interface_reserve.condition: Only if changed scale package/native route requires same original F1/F2 non-contact seam

operations.existing_D5_and_J: Finish under original500-update recipes and existing finite leases; no hotpatch, extension or cancellation by this publication
operations.scope: New scale recipe/checkpoint/package/resource identity; old D4/D5/J/M2 contracts preserved
operations.allocation: Actual finite scheduler allocation required; segment by full durable checkpoint; no automatic quota extension
operations.compute_estimate_reference: Old D4 ~10.89sec/update yields20k~60.5h at old recipe only; mixed128/full-action-expert cost must be measured
operations.resource_plan: Measure first technical prefix wall/step, VRAM, CPU, data wait, save/restore and total GPU-hours; do not multiply by fictional available GPUs
stop_on: native safety/evidence violation for the affected evaluation
operations.five_k_review: Inspect TRAIN fitting, independent DEV, per-domain progress, output diversity and closure; fixed recipe may continue when numerically healthy even at low native success
operations.twenty_k_review: Choose better data/capacity/loss if plateau; optional40k only as separately frozen continuation with its LR and resources
operations.WBC_and_hard_gates: Unchanged; no BASE head, no output shaping/selection, no real hardware
